subject: Helios Labs — mid-contract capacity increase and co-term options
messages:
From: Maria Gonzales <maria@helioslabs.com>

Cc: Anthony Park <anthony.park@helioslabs.com>

Subject: Quick scope question: add 30% capacity mid-term?

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the QBR last week — we appreciated the performance notes on prefix caching. We're seeing a spike in model usage driven by a new feature launch and we'd like to discuss adding roughly 30% capacity for the remainder of the contract period (current term ends 2027-02-28).

Primary asks:
- Can we get options for a mid-contract top-up that co-terms with our existing renewal (we'd prefer a single annual invoice if possible)?
- What proration mechanics do you support (monthly vs daily proration)?
- Any commitment discounts you can apply for an incremental uplift of this size?

Attached: Q3 usage dump and current SOW for reference. Procurement may be looped in shortly for PO timing.

Appreciate a high-level path and timeline — happy to hop on a call next week.

Best,
Maria Gonzales
Director of Platform Engineering
Helios Labs

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Quick scope question: add 30% capacity mid-term?

Hi Maria — thanks for the details and the exports.

High-level options I recommend (quick summary):
1) Staged top-up (preferred): add 30% committed capacity as a staged voucher that co-terms to 2027-02-28. Billing would be split across the remainder of the term (prorated monthly); rollout can be immediate. Typical discount for a one-time uplift of this size is in the 8–12% range on the incremental committed units.
2) True-up on usage: no commit; you pay overage at list rates, invoiced monthly. Higher short-term flexibility but no uplift discount.
3) Hybrid (30% commit with a smaller burst allowance): commit at a smaller uplift (15–20%) + burst buffer for peak. Discount sits between the two options.

If you prefer option 1 we can produce an invoice example and DocuSign amendment — takes ~3–5 business days once you confirm final uplift and PO routing. I copied Ben (AE) to align on pricing, and Naomi (CS) to validate rollout windows.

Proposed next step: 30 minute sync Thursday or Friday to lock the path and PO details. Let me know the best time.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Maria — quick follow to add pricing context.

Assuming a 30% uplift for the remainder of the term (approx 5 months):
- Option 1 (staged/top-up, co-term): incremental unit price reduction of 10% on the uplifted committed units vs current list, with prorated invoicing month-to-month.
- Option 2 (true-up): list overage at current rates (no discount).
- Option 3 (hybrid): 6% discount on the committed part + burst at list.

We can stretch to 12% on the committed uplift if Helios signs a short amendment committing to a minimum usage threshold (we'll detail in the amendment). Kimberly — are there any billing constraints to flag for a midterm amendment like this?

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Gonzales <maria@helioslabs.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 11:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick scope question: add 30% capacity mid-term? — billing mechanics

Hi all — looping in billing/ops details so procurement has what they need.

Mechanics for Option 1 (staged top-up, co-term):
- We create an amendment that increases committed units by 30%; effective date will be the first day of the next invoice period unless you request an immediate pro-rata start (we support daily proration with the following note).
- Proration: we offer both monthly and daily proration. If you want immediate capacity, we'll prorate the partial month daily and then bill full months thereafter.
- Invoice: single amendment invoice can be issued and applied to the next monthly bill; we can also provide a standalone one-off invoice if procurement requires a separate PO.
- Legal redlines: standard amendment language will include an updated commitment table + termination/crediting language. Procurement — if you have specific PO wording (e.g., supplier contact or unique billing address), send it and we'll ensure the DocuSign packet includes the fields.

Attachments: I attached a sample pricing matrix for the uplift (#helios_pricing_matrix.xlsx) and a sample amendment template.

Kimberly Park
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

- DocuSign amendment URL and any required PO fields.
- If you can confirm final discount band (10% vs 12%) and the exact threshold we need to hit for 12% (monthly committed units), we can route this fast.

We prefer staged/top-up and immediate start (daily proration for the remainder of September, then full months). Can you send the sample invoice and a draft amendment for review?
